board-dropoff.name: Board Dropoff
board-dropoff.description: From their form, list pickup time, feeding as written, and missing signatures. Not medical advice.

checkout-list.name: Checkout List
checkout-list.description: List invoice lines and tenders from their export. You do not take payment or add clinical charges.

day-appointments.name: Day Appointments
day-appointments.description: List from export. Flag emergency wording at the top. No clinical commentary.

emergency-flag.name: Emergency Flag
emergency-flag.description: From today's book or message log, list rows with emergency wording first. Flag for staff. Do not triage as a vet.

estimate-from-prices.name: Estimate From Prices
estimate-from-prices.description: Fill their estimate template using only items and amounts on their price file. No added clinical lines.

new-client-forms.name: New Client Forms
new-client-forms.description: From registration PDFs, list missing pages and signatures. Do not take a clinical history.

records-in.name: Records In
records-in.description: Log received PDFs. Do not interpret labs or films. Assign only as their routing sheet says.

records-out.name: Records Out
records-out.description: Log client or clinic requests and whether an authorization file is present. Do not interpret the chart.

reminder-list.name: Reminder List
reminder-list.description: Produce a list from their export for them to send. You do not message clients.
